audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer misgenders Lulu as male three times ('Track his engage cooldown', 'his duo's sustain', 'his engage cooldown').
audit.why: Lulu is on the FEMALE list in champ-data/champ-gender.js. The owner (Senna) is 'you', so any third-person pronoun refers to Lulu and must be 'she/her'.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] (Itemization) says 'Add anti-heal early into his duo's sustain', but Lulu's kit has no heal ability at all — P Pix, Q Glitterlance, W Whimsy, E Help Pix!, and R Wild Growth are all slow/shield/polymorph/knockup, none flagged heal.
audit.why: This is the generic anti-heal boilerplate pasted onto a champion who provides zero self/ally healing (peel via shields and polymorph, not sustain), matching the content layer's own framing ('a pure enchanter' with nothing to shield-heal through).
audit.corrected: Removed the ungrounded anti-heal clause and replaced it with a grounded note about her shield/polymorph peel instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0].side and phases[1].side both read 'Skill' while content win[0] and win[1] already read 'Senna'.
audit.why: Content's whys[0-1] give the specific reason: Senna's Q poke and range beat Lulu's shield-only early kit, and Lulu has no return damage to punish back with — a clean owner-favor read, not a coin-flip.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0-1].side to 'Senna', raised ratings, and rewrote the whys to match the already-correct content reasoning. win[0-1] left untouched since they already read 'Senna'.
